description.en: Returns the character handle of a map NPC encounter, by encounter index (see ie4_ev_sub_enc.nut, the script for NPCs that trigger a challenge when talked to).
Index of the encounter, from CMND_GET_ENCCHR_INDEX.
Handle of the encounter's NPC character.

example.code:
// Get the character handle of the NPC that triggered this encounter
local encChrHdl = CMND_GET_ENCCHR_HANDLE(encIndex);
